description: Run a shell command as a Dagster asset via subprocess (bash -c) -- the Airflow BashOperator / @task.bash equivalent.

outputs.description: Run a shell command as a Dagster asset via subprocess (bash -c).

command.description: Shell command (or multiline script) to execute, run via bash -c. Required unless command_asset_key is set.
command.label: Command

env_vars.description: Additional env vars to pass to the shell.
env_vars.label: Env Vars

deps.description: Upstream Dagster asset keys for lineage.
deps.label: Deps

command_asset_key.label: Command Asset Key
command_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key whose materialized value becomes the command string to run -- mirrors Airflow's `@task.bash`, where the decorated Python callable's return value IS the command. Adds that asset as a dependency automatically.

skip_on_exit_code.label: Skip On Exit Code
skip_on_exit_code.description: Exit code treated as a no-op success instead of a failure (Airflow's BashOperator default is 99 -- not defaulted here since this component predates this field and existing YAML may rely on every nonzero exit code failing the run; set explicitly to opt in, e.g. 99 for Airflow parity). The asset still materializes successfully; metadata records `skipped: true` and the exit code.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Kill the command and fail the run if it runs longer than this many seconds. Unset: no timeout.

success_exit_codes.label: Success Exit Codes
success_exit_codes.description: Additional exit codes treated as a normal, successful materialization -- unlike skip_on_exit_code, no 'skipped' metadata marker, just success. For legacy scripts that exit nonzero on 'nothing to do' and should count as success, not a no-op. Checked before skip_on_exit_code and before the exit-code!=0 failure; 0 is always success and never needs to be listed here.

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: 0 (default): a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows. 1: include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the partitions definition (defaults to UTC).

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Policy Max Partitions Per Run

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

pool.label: Pool
pool.description: Dagster's native named concurrency pool (e.g. Airflow's `pool` -- a fixed number of slots shared across every asset/op using the same pool name). The pool's own slot count is configured at the deployment level (dagster.yaml's concurrency: pools:, or the Dagster+ UI), not here.

return_last_stdout_line.label: Return Last Stdout Line
return_last_stdout_line.description: Return the command's last non-empty stdout line as this asset's materialized value (via the IO manager), not just metadata, so a downstream asset can take it as an input the usual way. Mirrors what a source system's last line of output is read as by its own downstream steps. Off by default.

parse_json_output.label: Parse Json Output
parse_json_output.description: Only with return_last_stdout_line: if that last line parses as valid JSON, return the parsed value instead of the raw string. Falls back to the raw string when it isn't valid JSON.

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: If True, log the fully-resolved command (after {partition_key} substitution) and skip actually running it -- no subprocess is spawned. Output metadata always includes dry_run so a materialization history shows which runs were real.

run_window.label: Run Window
run_window.description: 'HH:MM-HH:MM tz [day,day,...]' (e.g. '09:00-17:00 America/New_York mon,tue,wed,thu,fri'). Outside this window, the asset SKIPS cleanly instead of running or failing -- the command does not run, and real downstream dependents skip too (not fail). Checked once per materialization, before dry_run or the command itself. A malformed spec fails open (never blocks). Unset (default): always runs.

name: ShellCommandAsset
